# Placeholder file — real imagefs.tar.gz must be generated by the developer
# using tools/build-imagefs.sh on a Linux PC.
#
# The real imagefs.tar.gz should be ~220 MB and contain:
#   usr/bin/wine, wineserver, waylandie-*, vkcube, vulkaninfo, weston
#   usr/lib/libvulkan_freedreno.so (Turnip KGSL bionic)
#   usr/etc/vulkan/icd.d/freedreno_icd.json
#   opt/wine/ (full wine install)
#   home/xuser/.wine (initialized Wine prefix)
#   usr/bin/box86, box64, FEXLoader
#   usr/bin/gamescope (optional)
#   usr/bin/pulseaudio, pacat (for audio bridge)
#
# See tools/build-imagefs.sh for the build script.
